home.title: We care for your smile, we transform your life
home.subtitle: Over 26 years transforming smiles in Lima. We specialize in oral rehabilitation, dental aesthetics and implants, giving you back confidence when you speak, smile and eat.
home.featured_services_subtitle: High-quality dental treatments for the whole family

services.hero_subtitle: We offer comprehensive dental treatments with cutting-edge technology and highly trained professionals.

orthodontics.name: Orthodontics
orthodontics.description: Bracket placement with personalized check-ups and follow-up throughout treatment, until you achieve an aligned, functional smile. Direct financing with no interest or surcharges.

implants.name: Dental Implants
implants.description: Personalized evaluation with a CT scan, safe implant placement and crown fitting in porcelain or zirconia. Recover your missing tooth naturally, without affecting neighboring teeth.

emergency.name: Dental Emergencies
emergency.description: Immediate attention for acute pain, swelling or other dental trauma. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll help resolve your emergency as soon as possible.

oralRehab.name: Oral Rehabilitation
oralRehab.description: Full and removable dentures, crowns and bridges in porcelain or zirconia. We restore chewing function and the aesthetics of your smile with solutions tailored to each case.

aesthetics.name: Dental Aesthetics
aesthetics.description: Aesthetic restorations and veneers in resin, porcelain or zirconia. We harmonize the shape and color of your teeth for a natural, balanced smile.

surgery.name: Dental Surgery
surgery.description: Simple extractions, wisdom teeth, impacted or supernumerary teeth and mucocele surgery. Safe procedures under strict biosafety protocols.

endodontics.name: Endodontics
endodontics.description: Root canal treatment to save teeth with damaged or infected pulp. Eliminates pain and preserves your natural tooth, avoiding extraction.

about.hero_subtitle: Over 26 years committed to the oral health of Los Olivos and Lima.
about.doctor_subtitle: Dental Surgeon · Implantology, Oral Rehabilitation & Aesthetics
about.doctor_bio: I'm Dr. Daniel Tello, a dentist specializing in implantology, oral rehabilitation and aesthetics, with over 26 years of experience caring for your oral health. Throughout my career, I've put my knowledge and skills at the service of my patients, combining personalized care with the latest dental techniques. My motivation is to see you regain confidence when you smile, speak and eat; that's why I keep training continuously and work under strict biosafety protocols, using high-quality materials. My biggest challenge: seeing you smile again with satisfaction, freedom and confidence.

doctor_education.degree: Universidad Inca Garcilaso de la Vega — Undergraduate Degree in Dentistry
doctor_education.spec1: GROIS Institute, Rio Branco, Brazil — Continuing education and advanced training courses
doctor_education.spec2: Faculdade do Centro Oeste Paulista (FACOP), Brazil — Specialty in Implantology, Oral Rehabilitation & Aesthetics

about.facilities_subtitle: A modern, comfortable space designed for your peace of mind.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Friendly, sincere and honest treatment: we will always tell you the truth about your oral health. Over 26 years back every relationship we build with our patients.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: We have digital X-ray, electrosurgery, dental laser, state-of-the-art implant equipment and dry-heat and autoclave sterilization for your maximum safety.

warmth.title: Warmth
warmth.description: We understand that visiting the dentist can cause anxiety. That's why we create a welcoming environment where every patient feels safe and well cared for.

cases.hero_subtitle: Real results from patients treated at our clinic, documented at every stage of treatment.
cases.disclaimer: All photographs correspond to real cases treated at our clinic and are published with each patient's consent.

limpiezaDental.title: Dental Cleaning
limpiezaDental.description: Deep cleaning with stain and tartar removal, restoring a healthier, brighter look to the teeth.

resinaAnterior.title: Anterior Aesthetic Resin
resinaAnterior.description: Resin restoration of a front tooth to bring back a natural, harmonious smile.

resinasMolares.title: Molar Resin Fillings
resinasMolares.description: Cavity treatment in molars with composite resin, built to withstand chewing wear.

reparacionCuellos.title: Cervical Repair
reparacionCuellos.description: Correction of cervical wear to protect the tooth root and reduce sensitivity.

incrustacionesResina.title: Direct Resin Inlay
incrustacionesResina.description: Full process of a dental inlay: isolation, preparation and placement of the restoration.

pernoCorona.title: Fiber Post & Crown
pernoCorona.description: Reconstruction of a severely damaged tooth with a fiberglass post as the crown's foundation.

protesisTotal.title: Full Denture
protesisTotal.description: Complete rehabilitation with a removable denture, restoring aesthetics and chewing function.

protocoloImplantes.title: Implant-Supported Rehabilitation
protocoloImplantes.description: Fixed prosthesis protocol on dental implants, from the working model to the final result.

resinaEstetica.title: Aesthetic Molar Resin
resinaEstetica.description: Treatment of multiple cavities with resin, preserving as much healthy tooth structure as possible.

appointments.faq_subtitle: We answer our patients' most common questions.

q1.question: Do you accept health insurance or EPS?
q1.answer: At this time we do not work with health insurance or EPS plans.

q2.question: Do you offer payment plans or financing?
q2.answer: Yes. We offer direct financing for implants and orthodontics, plus payment plans for other treatments, with no interest or surcharges.

q3.question: How long does an evaluation appointment take?
q3.answer: It depends on the case: it can take between 15 minutes and 2 hours, depending on the treatment being evaluated.

q4.question: From what age do you treat children?
q4.answer: Yes, we treat children from 5 months of age, with guidance for parents on their children's oral care.

q5.question: What should I do if I have a dental emergency outside office hours?
q5.answer: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll help you resolve your emergency as soon as possible.
